headline: Line extension: a pellet formulation of a drug already on the market; first on the wire at 07:08 ET
reasoning: Primary source: BioCryst's press release on GlobeNewswire, 'BioCryst Announces U.S. FDA Approval of ORLADEYO 150 mg Oral Pellets'. The first report was at 07:08 ET (Benzinga 11:08 UTC: 'FDA Approves BioCryst Pharma’s sNDA For Use Of Oral Pellet Formulation Of Once-Daily ORLADEYO'); the watcher's 09:32 item is a rewrite.

Quoted from the summary: an approved 'supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for an oral pellet formulation of ORLADEYO (berotralstat)' for 'patients who may have difficulty swallowing capsules or who prefer a different method of administration'.
What changed: a second way to take a drug BioCryst already sells, for the same disease and the same ages. It is a convenience option, not a new indication or a new market.
Price: BCRX is +0.6% against yesterday's close (7.935 to 7.985) since the 07:08 report. The market agrees it is small.
objections: Immaterial line extension (new formulation, same indication); first reported before the open.
